description: AI assistants and model tooling: Claude, Codex, ChatGPT, Cursor, local models.

rules.name: Claude desktop VM images
rules.reason: Virtual-machine images Claude desktop uses to run tools in a sandbox.
rules.regenerates: Claude downloads them again the next time it needs the sandbox.

rules.name: Old Claude Code session transcripts
rules.reason: Conversation logs for projects you haven't used in Claude Code for a while. Needed only to --resume those old sessions.

rules.name: Old Codex session logs
rules.reason: Recorded Codex sessions from more than a month ago. Needed only to resume or review those sessions.

rules.name: Codex temp & cache
rules.reason: Temporary files and caches Codex recreates on demand.

rules.name: Old Codex worktrees
rules.reason: Git worktrees Codex created for tasks. Unmerged work in them would be lost.

rules.name: Old Codex task folder
rules.reason: Workspace Codex created for a task more than a month ago. Check nothing in it is still needed.

rules.name: ChatGPT app cache
rules.reason: Cache files for the ChatGPT desktop apps. Your chats live on OpenAI's servers.
rules.regenerates: Rebuilt as you use the app.

rules.name: Cursor editor caches
rules.regenerates: Rebuilt when you open a project.

rules.name: Downloaded Hugging Face models
rules.reason: Model weights downloaded by transformers/diffusers. Re-downloadable, but large and slow to fetch again.

rules.name: Ollama / LM Studio models
rules.reason: Local language models. Remove ones you no longer run.
rules.advice: Use `ollama list` / `ollama rm <model>` (or LM Studio's My Models) so the app's index stays consistent.

rules.name: PyTorch hub cache
rules.reason: Pretrained weights downloaded by torch.hub / torchvision.
rules.regenerates: Downloaded again when code requests them.
